sentences.7.1 Unnskyld, hvordan kommer jeg til Fro: 7.1 Excuse me, how do I get to Frognerparken?
sentences.Biniam tar toget til Oslo og går av på O: Biniam takes the train to Oslo and gets off at Oslo S.
sentences.Han skal møte ei venninne i Frognerparke: He is going to meet a friend in Frognerparken.
sentences.Venninna heter Sara, og Biniam gleder se: His friend is called Sara, and Biniam is looking forward to meeting her, but where is Frognerparken?
sentences.Biniam tar fram mobilen og slår på GPS-e: Biniam takes out his mobile and turns on the GPS to find Frognerparken.
sentences.Han går gjennom Oslo S og finner Karl Jo: He walks through Oslo S and finds Karl Johans gate.
sentences.Så går han Karl Johans gate opp til Slot: Then he walks up Karl Johans gate to the Royal Palace.
Suddenly his mobile's battery is dead.
sentences.Hva skal han gjøre nå?: What is he going to do now?
sentences.Biniam går litt fram og tilbake, men han: Biniam walks back and forth a bit, but he can't find the way.
He asks a woman for help.
sentences.Unnskyld, hvordan kommer jeg til Frogner: Excuse me, how do I get to Frognerparken?
sentences.Trikk nummer 12 går dit. Du kan gå til v: Tram number 12 goes there. You can turn left here and take the tram over there on the other side of the street.
sentences.Hvor lang tid tar det til Frognerparken: How long does it take to Frognerparken by tram?
sentences.Biniam tar trikken og går av ved Frogner: Biniam takes the tram and gets off at Frognerparken.
sentences.Hvordan skal han finne Sara?: How is he going to find Sara?
sentences.De skal møtes ved Monolitten, en stor st: They're going to meet at the Monolith, a big statue, but where is it?
sentences.Unnskyld, hvor er Monolitten?: Excuse me, where is the Monolith?
sentences.Du går til høyre og over broen der. Så g: Go right and over the bridge there. Then go straight on, and there you'll see a very tall statue with lots of people. That's the Monolith.
sentences.Hvor langt er det å gå dit?: How far is it to walk there?
sentences.Biniam finner Monolitten og ser mange tu: Biniam finds the Monolith and sees lots of tourists, but he doesn't see Sara.
sentences.Biniam kan ikke ringe til henne, for mob: Biniam can't call her, because his mobile is dead.
sentences.«Hva gjorde folk i gamle dager uten mobi: "What did people do in the old days without mobile phones?" he thinks.
sentences.Han setter seg i trappa foran statuen og: He sits down on the steps in front of the statue and waits.
Oslo is the capital of Norway.
Lots of tourists visit Oslo every year.
sentences.De vil se Holmenkollen, Frognerparken, S: They want to see Holmenkollen, Frognerparken, the Royal Palace and the Opera House, and many go to museums.
sentences.Munchmuseet, Norsk Folkemuseum og Kon-Ti: The Munch Museum, the Norwegian Folk Museum and the Kon-Tiki Museum are examples of popular museums in Oslo.
